'''Yalor''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who held the rank of [[Major/Legends|Major]] by the time of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He was the programmer of the [[Slave circuit]] that guided pilots through [[The Gauntlet (Arda I)|The Gauntlet]].

==Appearance==
Yalor was a Sullustan with pronounced jowls and a short stature. What set him apart in appearance was a cluster of birthmarks on his cheek that he believed to be a sign of luck.

==Appearances==
*''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' {{1st}}
